item.title: A promising new medicine against heart disease fails unexpectedly
item.description: Doctors expected an experimental drug that lowers a common risk factor for heart attacks would save patients' lives. The medicine made no difference.

item.title: This teen boy set out to get people talking about periods. He's now a Diana honoree
item.description: This year's the Princess Diana honor roll highlights 198 inspiring young activists and advocates — including an 18-year-old guy in India who founded Team Period.

item.title: Health intel-sharing group warns industry in wake of cyberattack on French blood bank
item.description: A healthcare intelligence-sharing organization is warning its members to lock down systems following cyberattacks on cold storage systems, including a French blood bank.

item.title: Past White House adviser Raj Panjabi has written a playbook for 'living room' crises
item.description: Dr. Raj Panjabi is the author of Safer: A Playbook. His goal is to help people face a personal crisis — health, workplace, family conflicts — and "turn fear into action."

item.description: A new study looks at the recommended amount of daily exercise for adolescents — and how few are getting it.

item.title: It was a big night for doctors to win seats in Congress, riding the blue wave
item.description: Historically, most physicians who served in the House or Senate have been Republicans. In the next Congress, physicians who are Democrats made significant gains.

item.title: This woman defied lethal cancer. Can mRNA vaccines make that possible for others?
item.description: Researchers have been chasing the dream of a cancer vaccine for decades. Some recent successes with mRNA technology are garnering excitement from patients, doctors, government and investors.

item.title: Do you know signs of a stroke? BE FAST are the words to remember
item.description: Sen. Chris Murphy is expected to fully recover from his stroke. The acronym BE FAST can help you remember the symptoms of stroke and what to do when it happens: Call 911 quickly.
